name: B2B domain enrichment and EU VAT lookup — marketplace client

nodes.name: Set gateway and input
nodes.notes: Set the actual subscribed gateway origin. Select a matching Header Auth credential in the next node. Keep secrets out of this node.

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const p = $json.platform; const b = String($json.baseUrl || '').replace(/\/$/, ''); const ok = p === 'rapidapi' ? /^https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+\.p\.rapidapi\.com$/.test(b) : p === 'jojapi' && /^https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+\.jojapi\.(net|dev)$/.test(b); if (!ok) throw new Error('Set the actual HTTPS marketplace gateway origin.'); const route = $json.endpoint; if (!['/v1/full-enrich','/v1/eu-vat-validator','/v1/impressum-legal','/v1/dns-email-intel'].includes(route)) throw new Error('Unsupported endpoint path.'); const directVat = route === '/v1/eu-vat-validator' && String($json.vat || '').trim(); const value = directVat || String($json.domain || '').trim(); if (!value) throw new Error('Set a domain or a VAT number.'); return b + route + '?' + (directVat ? 'vat=' : 'domain=') + encodeURIComponent(value) + '&fresh=' + ($json.fresh === true ? 'true' : 'false'); })() }}

nodes.name: Call subscribed endpoint
nodes.notes: Choose Header Auth: X-JoJAPI-Key for JoJAPI, or X-RapidAPI-Key for RapidAPI. The key stays in n8n credentials. No automatic retry; redirects disabled.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(item => ({ json: { http_status: item.json.statusCode, success: item.json.statusCode === 200 && item.json.body?.success === true, response: item.json.body, response_headers: item.json.headers } }));
